en: Distinctions Concerning the Mixing of Abhidhamma and Citta (Mind)

For whom a wholesome consciousness arises … for whom an unwholesome consciousness arises … for whom an indeterminate consciousness arises … for whom a consciousness associated with pleasant feeling arises …?
(By this method, [the categories] up to *saraṇa* and *araṇa* should be extracted.
For whom a non-conflict (*araṇa*) consciousness arises and does not cease, will that non-conflict consciousness cease and not arise for them?
Or again, for whomsoever the non-conflict mind will cease and will not arise, does the non-conflict mind arise and not cease for that person?
This is the section on enunciation.
